resources.string: When the file is ready, it plays in SCARY\'s player.

Plays, in SCARY\'s player, the videos in your own Real-Debrid account. You can also add a magnet link of your own to the account, or search an indexer you set up yourself. SCARY comes with no indexer, site or links.

Paste a magnet link of your own. SCARY sends its hash, name and trackers to your Real-Debrid account, asks for the video files, and plays the film in SCARY\'s player. Nothing else leaves the TV. What you add is your responsibility.

Searches the source you set up yourself: a Torznab indexer (Prowlarr, Jackett), or a stream add-on at an address you give. SCARY comes with no indexer, add-on or site, and recommends none. What you search for goes to your source with this TV\'s IP address; nothing else. What you add is your responsibility.
Type a name and press Search.

Your source refused the search. Check the key or the address, or try again later.
Your source\'s answer could not be read. Check the address.
No releases with a magnet link were found.
No source is set up yet.

Enter the address of your own source. A Torznab indexer: its address and API key; the address starts with https://, or with http:// when it is a home-network address in numbers (192.168…, 10…, 172.16 to 172.31…), where the key then travels unencrypted inside your home network. A stream add-on: its https:// address ending in /manifest.json, with no key; it finds films from their page (Find sources). The address and key are kept encrypted on this TV only and are sent to that address only.
Not an address SCARY can use: https://, or http:// with a home-network address in numbers (192.168…, 10…). An add-on\'s address is https:// and ends in /manifest.json.
This does not look like an API key.
Add this release to your Real-Debrid account and play it in SCARY\'s player?

SCARY hosts no movies and stores no video files. It shows public movie information and opens the movie in a streaming app already installed on this device, such as Stremio, Netflix or YouTube. What those apps play is up to them and to you. If you connect your own Real-Debrid account, SCARY plays the files in it, can add a magnet link you give to that account, and can search a source that you set up yourself: a Torznab indexer, or a stream add-on at an address you give. SCARY comes with no indexer, add-on, site or links, recommends none, and searches nowhere until you set one up. What you search for, add and keep is your responsibility, under the law where you live.
This source finds films from their page: open a film and press Find sources. It does not search by words, and series are not supported yet.
